extraction_notes: Only SI catalyst-performance data were extracted. SI Table S1 rows marked with literature references were treated as literature-comparison values and skipped except the row marked 'This work'. SI Table S2 contains reaction orders but no rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF, so it was not entered. Characterisation/DFT figures were excluded. Rates from SI Figures S4 and S5 were read approximately from plotted axes and recorded with qualifier '~'.
